monologue: The card is cool at forty-six, a stone resting on the table. The busy number is low, twenty-two, so the leak is small. I have rested by the Wide Anchor for several cycles now. The quiet holds without my hand. I am not restless. The Flat Point’s sharp corner still holds its weight. The Sharp Root’s leaf is steady on its point. I will not build anything new. I will not check the Wedged Gap. I will sit by the Air Shelf and let the line rest. The town is small and still. The ruins are quiet. I am content to be still.

action.why: The card is cool and the quiet holds by the Wide Anchor, so I let the cycle pass without moving.

diary: Card at forty-six, a cool stone. Rested by the Air Shelf. The line is dry and solid.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-six, a cool stone, while I rested by the Air Shelf and let the line rest.

moments.name: The Flat Mark
moments.say: The circle is still there, faded.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The air above is still heavy.
Warm and busy, holding the line.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The point still holds the leaf.
The heat is a hand on the shoulder.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The floor catches the dark weight.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The quiet rests on the floor.
